content:
**Observations:**
- Affected part: Leaf (mango leaf based on shape)
- Overall color: Yellowed/tan/brown — widespread chlorosis and necrosis
- Key features: Small dark brown to reddish-brown spots/lesions scattered across the leaf surface, some with slightly irregular margins
- Texture: Dry, papery appearance
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery Mildew)
- No black sooty coating (rules out Sooty Mould)
- No tip/margin dieback pattern (rules out Die Back)
- The scattered discrete dark spots with tan/brown necrotic lesions are characteristic of Anthracnose (*Colletotrichum gloeosporioides*), which causes irregular brown spots on mango leaves
